notes.title: Crazy Brain Enhancement Update
notes.content:
Crazy Brain Enhancement Update Game Version 2.0 includes:

-Many replaced and improved sprites, graphics and backgrounds
-Entirely NEW Soundtrack.  All audio tracks/music have been completely replaced
-One new achievement
-Various Bug Fixes and Polish

*This update is only available for the Windows Operating System

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
-Added Tutorial Stage for New Players to demonstrate Gameplay
-Improve Pause Function
-Added Sprites

tags.feature: -Added Tutorial Stage for New Players to demonstrate Gameplay

notes.title: CRAZY BRAIN IMPACT UPDATE
notes.content:
-Added Impact effects that occur at specified points of impact when meeting certain conditions
-Added Goal Arrow to the start of each round to clearly show where to aim for to end the round
-Added more ways to collect & stack Points
-Added to the User Interface
-Changed and replace some Audio FX
-Completely Replaced the Game Over Animation
-plus much adjustments and tweaks to the game logic

notes.title: Brain Aesthetic Patch 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Brain Aesthetic Patch 1.0.0.4 for September 25th 2023 replaced the Sprite for the Brain with a New Brain Sprite that looks more like an anatomically correct brain.

-Applied the New Brain to all areas of which the brain is associated

-Also fixed a specific pause screen/menu bug and now the pause screen menu works perfectly

notes.title: Gamepad Config Patch+ for August 20th 2023
notes.content:
-Added Full Gamepad support via Steam's configuration UI using the default configuration titled "Crazy Brain TVS Official Config"

-Removed hidden Reset button which erased the player's progress if accidently pressed

-Fixed the pause menu selection screen to properly scroll up and down the list

-Added a gamepad controls page referencing the "Crazy Brain TVS Official Config" control layout

-Added a couple new sprites, changed the control menu page access button from "C" to "D"

-Optimized the logic for the intro TV blast
